custom_container_instructions: Client-only containers (no domain suffixes). voltaic=default (auto-capture target + operational context). Other containers (mobilemd, west_shore_chamber, etc.) store client business context only — brand voice, audience data, campaign history, business objectives, market context. Store tool writes to active client container only (skip when active client is voltaic — auto-capture handles it). Recall runs two searches per task: (1) voltaic for operational/technical, (2) active client container for business context. Skip search #2 when client=voltaic.
